description: Power University members at Candidate, Frontrunner or Nominee: people other members put forward to run for office, the same list the site shows on powerplayers.app/u. Each has a name, stage, office sought, place and state, the member's own reason for running, and links to their Power U profile and (once made) their candidate page. Filter by a two-letter state or a stage. Explorer and Contender members stay private and are never listed. A Power University stage is not an official filing; say so when it matters. Empty with a note when Power University is not open.
name: list_power_u_candidates
title: List Power U candidates
